title: Punishment for Murder
legal_text: Whoever commits murder shall be punished with death or imprisonment for life, and shall also be liable to fine.
simple_explanation: If someone unlawfully kills another person with the intent to kill (or knowledge that their act is likely to cause death), it is murder, and it carries the harshest penalties in Indian criminal law.
purpose: Protects the right to life by deterring and punishing unlawful killing.
punishment: Death or imprisonment for life, and fine.
relevant_documents: FIR, post-mortem/medical report, forensic evidence, witness statements.
source: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 (Act No. 45 of 2023), Government of India. Official text is published at indiacode.nic.in; this entry was cross-verified against multiple independent legal-reference sources reproducing the bare act (apnilaw.com, lawrato.com, devgan.in, testbook.com) since the official site blocks automated fetches.
source_name: India Code — Ministry of Law & Justice, Govt. of India
simple_explanation_te: చంపాలనే ఉద్దేశంతో లేదా తీవ్ర గాయం ద్వారా మరణం సంభవిస్తుందని తెలిసి ఎవరైనా మరొక వ్యక్తిని చట్టవిరుద్ధంగా చంపితే, అది హత్య అవుతుంది. భారత క్రిమినల్ చట్టంలో ఇది అత్యంత కఠినమైన శిక్షను కలిగి ఉంటుంది.
purpose_te: చట్టవిరుద్ధమైన హత్యను నిరోధించడం మరియు శిక్షించడం ద్వారా జీవించే హక్కును రక్షిస్తుంది.
punishment_te: మరణశిక్ష లేదా జీవిత ఖైదు, మరియు జరిమానా కూడా విధించబడుతుంది.
relevant_documents_te: FIR, పోస్ట్‌మార్టం/వైద్య నివేదిక, ఫోరెన్సిక్ ఆధారాలు, సాక్షుల వాంగ్మూలాలు.
title_hi: हत्या के लिए सज़ा
simple_explanation_hi: यदि कोई व्यक्ति किसी अन्य व्यक्ति को जान से मारने के इरादे से (या यह जानते हुए कि उसके कृत्य से मृत्यु होना निश्चित है) मारता है, तो यह हत्या है। भारतीय कानून में इसके लिए कठोरतम दंड का प्रावधान है।
punishment_hi: मृत्युदंड या आजीवन कारावास, और जुर्माना भी लगाया जा सकता है।
example_title: Scenario: Premeditated Fatal Attack
example_title_te: పరిస్థితి: ముందస్తు ప్రణాళికతో జరిగిన ప్రాణాంతక దాడి
example_title_hi: परिदृश्य: पूर्व-नियोजित जानलेवा हमला
example_situation: Suppose Person A holds a long-standing financial grudge against Person B. Person A buys a lethal weapon, lies in wait outside Person B's home, and deliberately attacks Person B with fatal strikes, resulting in Person B's death.
example_situation_te: వ్యక్తి A కి వ్యక్తి B పై పాత ఆర్థిక కక్ష ఉందని అనుకుందాం. వ్యక్తి A ప్రాణాంతక ఆయుధాన్ని కొనుగోలు చేసి, వ్యక్తి B ఇంటి బయట కాపుకాసి, ఉద్దేశపూర్వకంగా తీవ్రంగా దాడి చేసి చంపాడు.
example_situation_hi: मान लीजिए व्यक्ति A का व्यक्ति B से पुराना आर्थिक विवाद है। व्यक्ति A घातक हथियार खरीदता है, व्यक्ति B के घर के बाहर घात लगाकर बैठता है और जानबूझकर उस पर घातक वार करता है, जिससे B की मृत्यु हो जाती है।
example_explanation: Because there was clear intent to kill and premeditation without legal justification, the act falls under murder punishable under BNS Section 103(1). If convicted beyond reasonable doubt, the court may sentence the offender to life imprisonment or death, along with a fine.
example_explanation_te: ఎటువంటి చట్టబద్ధమైన కారణం లేకుండా చంపాలనే స్పష్టమైన ఉద్దేశం మరియు ముందస్తు ప్రణాళిక ఉన్నందున, ఇది BNS సెక్షన్ 103(1) క్రింద హత్యగా పరిగణించబడుతుంది. నేరం నిరూపితమైతే జీవిత ఖైదు లేదా మరణశిక్ష మరియు జరిమానా విధించవచ్చు.
example_explanation_hi: चूंकि बिना किसी कानूनी बचाव के जान से मारने का स्पष्ट इरादा और पूर्व-नियोजन था, इसलिए यह कृत्य बीएनएस धारा 103(1) के तहत हत्या का अपराध बनता है। दोष सिद्ध होने पर आजीवन कारावास या मृत्युदंड और जुर्माना हो सकता है।
example_disclaimer: Fictional educational example. This scenario is provided only to help explain the legal concept and does not represent an actual case.

what_you_should_do:
1. In an emergency, immediately call Police at 112 and Ambulance at 108.
2. Do not disturb or contaminate the crime scene or physical objects.
3. Assist law enforcement officers with accurate eyewitness statements.
4. Preserve any digital evidence such as CCTV footage or mobile recordings safely.
what_you_should_do_te:
1. అత్యవసర పరిస్థితుల్లో వెంటనే 112 (పోలీస్) మరియు 108 (అంబులెన్స్) కు కాల్ చేయండి.
2. ఘటనా స్థలాన్ని లేదా వస్తువులను చెదరగొట్టవద్దు.
3. విచారణ అధికారులకు ఖచ్చితమైన సమాచారం మరియు ప్రత్యక్ష సాక్ష్యాలను అందించండి.
4. సీసీటీవీ ఫుటేజ్ లేదా వీడియో రికార్డింగుల వంటి డిజిటల్ ఆధారాలను సురక్షితంగా భద్రపరచండి.
what_you_should_do_hi:
1. आपातकाल में तुरंत पुलिस (112) और एम्बुलेंस (108) को कॉल करें।
2. घटनास्थल या सबूतों के साथ कोई छेड़छाड़ न करें।
3. जांच अधिकारियों को सही और स्पष्ट प्रत्यक्षदर्शी बयान दें।
4. सीसीटीवी फुटेज या मोबाइल रिकॉर्डिंग जैसे डिजिटल साक्ष्यों को सुरक्षित रखें।

title: Cheating
legal_text: Whoever, by deceiving any person, fraudulently or dishonestly induces the person so deceived to deliver any property to any person, or to consent that any person shall retain any property, or intentionally induces the person so deceived to do or omit to do anything which he would not do or omit if he were not so deceived, and which act or omission causes or is likely to cause damage or harm to that person in body, mind, reputation or property, is said to cheat. A dishonest concealment of facts is a deception within the meaning of this section.
simple_explanation: Section 318 of BNS 2023 deals with cheating, covering intentional deception and fraudulent inducement to cause harm or deliver property. Sub-sections address different forms and consequences: general cheating under Section 318(2), cheating with breach of fiduciary duty under Section 318(3), and aggravated cheating dishonestly inducing delivery of property or valuable security under Section 318(4) (corresponding to former IPC Section 420).
purpose: Protects individuals and businesses from fraud and deception.
punishment: Graded by sub-section: General cheating under Section 318(2) carries imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both. Cheating with knowledge that the offender is bound to protect the victim's interest under Section 318(3) carries imprisonment up to 5 years, or fine, or both. Aggravated cheating inducing delivery of property or valuable security under Section 318(4) carries imprisonment up to 7 years and a mandatory fine.
relevant_documents: Bank statement highlighting fraudulent transactions, agreements/receipts/invoices, screenshots of chats, police complaint copy.
key_elements:
Deception of any person.
Fraudulent or dishonest inducement to deliver property or make payments.
Intentional inducement causing damage or harm to the person deceived.
relevant_information:
Communication records (messages, emails, call logs).
Bank transfer receipts, UPI transaction IDs, cheque copies.
Promises made in writing or verbally.
keywords: cheating, fraud, scam, deception, fake, duped, 420, money fraud, bns 318
source: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, Section 318. Cross-verified against lawrato.com, apnilaw.com, drishtijudiciary.com, and ezylegal.in. Note: the section's heading is 'Cheating' generally; 'inducing delivery of property' specifically describes sub-section (4).
source_name: India Code — Ministry of Law & Justice, Govt. of India
simple_explanation_te: BNS 2023 సెక్షన్ 318 మోసం గురించి వివరిస్తుంది. ఇది ఉద్దేశపూర్వక వంచన మరియు ఆస్తిని అప్పగించేలా మోసపూరితంగా ప్రేరేపించడాన్ని కవర్ చేస్తుంది. ఉప-విభాగాలు వివిధ స్థాయిల నేరాలను సూచిస్తాయి: సెక్షన్ 318(2) సాధారణ మోసం, సెక్షన్ 318(3) బాధ్యతాయుత విధుల ఉల్లంఘనతో మోసం, మరియు సెక్షన్ 318(4) ఆస్తి లేదా విలువైన సెక్యూరిటీని బదిలీ చేయించేలా మోసం చేయడం (గత IPC సెక్షన్ 420 కి సమానం).
purpose_te: వ్యక్తులను మరియు వ్యాపారాలను మోసం మరియు వంచన నుండి రక్షిస్తుంది.
punishment_te: ఉప-విభాగాల ప్రకారం శిక్షలు: సెక్షన్ 318(2) సాధారణ మోసానికి 3 సంవత్సరాల వరకు జైలు, లేదా జరిమానా, లేదా రెండూ. సెక్షన్ 318(3) కింద బాధితుడి ప్రయోజనాలను కాపాడాల్సిన వ్యక్తి మోసం చేస్తే 5 సంవత్సరాల వరకు జైలు. సెక్షన్ 318(4) కింద ఆస్తి డెలివరీకి ప్రేరేపిస్తే 7 సంవత్సరాల వరకు జైలు మరియు తప్పనిసరి జరిమానా.
key_elements_te:
ఏదైనా వ్యక్తిని మోసగించడం.
ఆస్తిని అప్పగించేలా లేదా చెల్లింపులు చేసేలా మోసపూరితంగా లేదా నిజాయితీ లేకుండా ప్రేరేపించడం.
మోసగించబడిన వ్యక్తికి హాని కలిగించే ఉద్దేశపూర్వక ప్రేరేపణ.
relevant_information_te:
కమ్యూనికేషన్ రికార్డులు (సందేశాలు, ఇమెయిల్‌లు, కాల్ లాగ్‌లు).
బ్యాంక్ బదిలీ రసీదులు, UPI లావాదేవీ IDలు, చెక్కు కాపీలు.
వ్రాతపూర్వకంగా లేదా మౌఖికంగా ఇచ్చిన వాగ్దానాలు.
relevant_documents_te: మోసపూరిత లావాదేవీలను చూపే బ్యాంక్ స్టేట్‌మెంట్, ఒప్పందాలు/రసీదులు/ఇన్వాయిస్‌లు, చాట్‌ల స్క్రీన్‌షాట్‌లు, పోలీసు ఫిర్యాదు కాపీ.
title_hi: धोखाधड़ी (चीटिंग)
simple_explanation_hi: बीएनएस 2023 की धारा 318 धोखाधड़ी से संबंधित है। इसके उप-भाग विभिन्न रूपों को कवर करते हैं: धारा 318(2) सामान्य धोखाधड़ी, धारा 318(3) कर्तव्य का उल्लंघन करते हुए धोखाधड़ी, और धारा 318(4) संपत्ति या मूल्यवान प्रतिभूति की सुपुर्दगी के लिए बेईमानी से प्रेरित करना (पूर्व आईपीसी धारा 420 के समकक्ष)।
punishment_hi: उप-धाराओं द्वारा वर्गीकृत: धारा 318(2) में 3 वर्ष तक का कारावास, या जुर्माना, या दोनों। धारा 318(3) में 5 वर्ष तक का कारावास, या जुर्माना, या दोनों। धारा 318(4) में 7 वर्ष तक का कारावास और अनिवार्य जुर्माना।
example_title: Scenario: Fraudulent Job Offer & Money Delivery
example_title_te: దృష్టాంతం: నకిలీ ఉద్యోగ ప్రతిపాదన & డబ్బు వసూలు
example_title_hi: परिदृश्य: फर्जी नौकरी का प्रस्ताव और धन की वसूली
example_situation: Suppose an individual poses as a senior government recruitment officer, presents fabricated appointment letters, and convinces a job seeker to transfer ₹3,00,000 for a guaranteed government posting.
example_situation_te: ఒక వ్యక్తి ప్రభుత్వ నియామక అధికారిగా నటిస్తూ, నకిలీ నియామక పత్రాలను చూపి, ఉద్యోగం ఇప్పిస్తానని చెప్పి ఒక నిరుద్యోగి వద్ద నుండి ₹3,00,000 నగదు బదిలీ చేయించుకున్నాడని అనుకుందాం.
example_situation_hi: मान लीजिए एक व्यक्ति सरकारी भर्ती अधिकारी होने का ढोंग करता है, फर्जी नियुक्ति पत्र दिखाता है और नौकरी की गारंटी के लिए ₹3,00,000 ट्रांसफर करवा लेता है।
example_explanation: Depending on the facts and the evidence, conduct involving intentional deception and dishonest inducement to deliver money or property may fall within the applicable provisions of Section 318. Where the facts establish dishonest inducement causing the victim to deliver money (valuable property), the situation satisfies the ingredients of Section 318(4). The exact subsection and charges depend on the specific facts and evidentiary proof established during legal proceedings.
example_explanation_te: వాస్తవాలు మరియు ఆధారాల ఆధారంగా, డబ్బు లేదా ఆస్తిని అప్పగించేలా ఉద్దేశపూర్వక వంచన మరియు మోసపూరిత ప్రేరణ కలిగించే చర్యలు సెక్షన్ 318 నిబంధనల పరిధిలోకి వస్తాయి. డబ్బు (విలువైన ఆస్తి) డెలివరీ జరిగినట్లు రుజువైతే సెక్షన్ 318(4) అంశాలు వర్తిస్తాయి. ఖచ్చితమైన ఉప-విభాగం కోర్టులో సమర్పించే ఆధారాలపై ఆధారపడి ఉంటుంది.
example_explanation_hi: तथ्यों और साक्ष्यों के आधार पर, धन या संपत्ति सौंपने के लिए जानबूझकर किया गया धोखा धारा 318 के तहत आ सकता है। जहां पैसे (संपत्ति) की डिलीवरी साबित होती है, वहां धारा 318(4) लागू हो सकती है। सटीक धारा कानूनी जांच और सबूतों पर निर्भर करती है।

what_you_should_do:
1. Preserve relevant evidence: Keep transaction records, UPI/bank UTR receipts, and account statements.
2. Save unaltered records: Retain screenshots of WhatsApp messages, emails, and fake documents without modification.
3. Contact appropriate authority: You may report the matter to the appropriate police or cybercrime authority (cybercrime.gov.in / helpline 1930). The applicable offences and procedure depend on the facts.
4. Inform your bank: Alert your bank or payment provider immediately when financial fraud is involved to attempt freezing the beneficiary account.
5. Seek legal assistance: Consult an advocate or free legal aid for formal petition and court proceedings.
what_you_should_do_te:
1. ఆధారాలను భద్రపరచుకోండి: లావాదేవీ రసీదులు, UPI/బ్యాంక్ UTR నంబర్లు మరియు స్టేట్‌మెంట్‌లను దాచండి.
2. అసలైన రికార్డులను ఉంచండి: వాట్సాప్ సందేశాలు, ఇమెయిల్‌లు మరియు నకిలీ పత్రాల స్క్రీన్‌షాట్‌లను మార్చకుండా సేవ్ చేయండి.
3. అధికారులను సంప్రదించండి: తగిన పోలీస్ లేదా సైబర్ క్రైమ్ పోర్టల్ (1930 / cybercrime.gov.in) లో ఫిర్యాదు చేయవచ్చు.
4. బ్యాంకుకు వెంటనే తెలియజేయండి: మోసపూరిత ఖాతాను స్తంభింపజేయడానికి బ్యాంకును వెంటనే సంప్రదించండి.
5. న్యాయ సహాయం పొందండి: న్యాయవాది లేదా ఉచిత న్యాయ సహాయాన్ని సంప్రదించండి.
what_you_should_do_hi:
1. साक्ष्य सुरक्षित रखें: लेनदेन की रसीदें, UPI/बैंक UTR नंबर और बैंक स्टेटमेंट संभाल कर रखें।
2. मूल रिकॉर्ड सहेजें: व्हाट्सएप संदेश, ईमेल और नकली दस्तावेजों के स्क्रीनशॉट बिना बदलाव के रखें।

title: Theft
legal_text:
Section 303. Theft.—
(1) Whoever, intending to take dishonestly any movable property out of the possession of any person without that person's consent, moves that property in order to such taking, is said to commit theft.
(2) Whoever commits theft shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years, or with fine, or with both, and in case of second or subsequent conviction, with rigorous imprisonment for a term which shall not be less than one year but which may extend to five years and with fine: Provided that where the value of stolen property is less than five thousand rupees, and a person is convicted for the first time, with community service.
simple_explanation: Taking someone else's movable property without their permission, intending to keep it dishonestly, is theft — for example, a phone, vehicle, or cash taken without consent.
purpose: Protects personal property from being dishonestly taken by others.
punishment: Up to 3 years jail, or fine, or both. First-time petty theft (< ₹5,000) punishable by mandatory community service.
relevant_documents: FIR / police complaint, proof of ownership/possession, police seizure memo, IMEI/serial number documentation.
key_elements:
The property must be movable (phone, vehicle, jewellery, cash).
The property was in the possession of another person.
The taking was done dishonestly, without the owner's consent.
The property was moved in order to take it.
relevant_information:
Exact date, time, and location where the property was last seen.
Proof of ownership (invoice, IMEI number, registration certificate).
Whether the item was locked, in a vehicle, or in a public space.
keywords: theft, stole, phone, stealing, laptop, wallet, property, dishonest, bns 303
amendment_info: Clarification on Community Service guidelines for first-time petty theft under BNS 303(2).

simple_explanation_te: చట్టం నిర్దేశించిన పద్ధతి ప్రకారం తప్ప ఏ వ్యక్తి యొక్క ప్రాణాన్ని లేదా వ్యక్తిగత స్వేచ్ఛను ప్రభుత్వం హరించకూడదు. ఇది గౌరవప్రదమైన జీవనం, గోప్యత మరియు ఉచిత న్యాయ సహాయాన్ని కల్పిస్తుంది.

punishment_te: రాజ్యాంగ నిబంధన — ఉల్లంఘన జరిగితే హైకోర్టు లేదా సుప్రీంకోర్టు ద్వారా రక్షణ లభిస్తుంది.
key_elements_te:
ఆస్తి కదిలేదిగా ఉండాలి (ఫోన్, వాహనం, నగలు, నగదు).
ఆస్తి మరొక వ్యక్తి స్వాధీనంలో ఉండాలి.
యజమాని అనుమతి లేకుండా నిజాయితీ లేకుండా తీసుకున్నారు.
తీసుకోవడానికి ఆస్తిని కదిలించారు.
relevant_information_te:
ఆస్తి చివరిగా కనిపించిన ఖచ్చితమైన తేదీ, సమయం, స్థలం.
యాజమాన్య రుజువు (ఇన్వాయిస్, IMEI నంబర్, రిజిస్ట్రేషన్ సర్టిఫికేట్).
వస్తువు లాక్ చేయబడిందా, వాహనంలో ఉందా, బహిరంగ ప్రదేశంలో ఉందా.
relevant_documents_te: FIR / పోలీసు ఫిర్యాదు, యాజమాన్యం/స్వాధీన రుజువు, పోలీసు స్వాధీన మెమో, IMEI/సీరియల్ నంబర్ డాక్యుమెంటేషన్.

title: Snatching
legal_text: Theft is 'snatching' if, in order to commit theft, the offender suddenly or quickly or forcibly seizes or secures or grabs or takes away from any person or from his possession any movable property.
simple_explanation: When someone suddenly grabs your phone or chain from your hand or neck and runs away, it is classified as snatching — a distinct, standalone offence with no direct IPC equivalent.
purpose: Provides a distinct legal provision addressing street crimes involving sudden, forcible grabbing of valuables.
punishment: Imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years, and the offender shall also be liable to fine.
relevant_documents: FIR copy, medical examination report if injury occurred, invoice showing ownership of the snatched item.
key_elements:
Commission of theft by sudden seizure or grabbing.
Property was held or worn by the person.
Sudden force or speed used to dispossess the owner.
relevant_information:
Exact spot of occurrence and route taken by the accused.
Vehicle description if a bike/scooter was used.
Any physical injury sustained during the snatching.
keywords: snatching, chain snatching, phone snatching, grabbed, street crime, bns 304

title: Robbery
legal_text: In all robbery there is either theft or extortion. Theft is robbery if, in order to the committing of the theft, or in committing the theft, or in carrying away property obtained by the theft, the offender voluntarily causes or attempts to cause death, hurt, or wrongful restraint, or fear of instant death, instant hurt, or instant wrongful restraint.
simple_explanation: If someone steals from you by threatening you, hurting you, or putting you in fear of physical harm, the offence escalates from simple theft to robbery.
purpose: Penalizes the violent element introduced during an unauthorized taking of property.
punishment: Rigorous imprisonment for a term up to 10 years, and fine; if committed on the highway between sunset and sunrise, up to 14 years. Attempted robbery: up to 7 years rigorous imprisonment and fine. Robbery causing hurt: imprisonment for life or rigorous imprisonment up to 10 years, and fine.
relevant_documents: FIR mentioning weapons/threats used, medico-legal case (MLC) report, witness statements.
key_elements:
Theft or extortion was being committed.
Offender caused, or attempted to cause, hurt, death, or wrongful restraint.
Action created immediate fear of physical harm.
relevant_information:
Nature of any weapon or threat used.
Number of persons involved.
Physical injuries caused to victim or bystanders.
keywords: robbery, threat, weapon, force, extortion, dacoity, bns 309

title: Criminal Breach of Trust
legal_text: Whoever, being in any manner entrusted with property, or with any dominion over property, dishonestly misappropriates or converts to his own use that property, or dishonestly uses or disposes of that property in violation of any direction of law or of any legal contract which he has made touching the discharge of such trust, commits criminal breach of trust.
simple_explanation: If you give your car, money, or goods to someone you trusted (an employee, partner, or custodian) for safekeeping, and they use it for their own gain without your permission, that is a criminal breach of trust.
purpose: Holds custodians, fiduciaries, and trustees accountable for entrusted property.
punishment: General offence: imprisonment up to 5 years, or fine, or both. Aggravated categories (carriers, warehouse-keepers, clerks/servants): up to 7 years and fine. By a public servant, banker, merchant, or agent: imprisonment for life or up to 10 years, and fine.
relevant_documents: Agreement/contract, receipts showing transfer of custody, legal notice demanding restitution, bank records.
key_elements:
Entrustment of property to the accused.
Dishonest misappropriation or conversion to their own use.
Violation of a legal direction or agreement governing the trust.
relevant_information:
Proof of entrustment (handover receipt, contract, partnership deed).
Demand notice requesting return of the property.
Refusal or evasive response from the accused.

title: Criminal Intimidation
legal_text: Whoever threatens another with any injury to his person, reputation or property, or to the person or reputation of any one in whom that person is interested, with intent to cause alarm to that person, or to cause that person to do any act which he is not legally bound to do, or to omit to do any act which that person is legally entitled to do, as the means of avoiding the execution of such threat, commits criminal intimidation.
simple_explanation: When someone threatens to beat you up, ruin your reputation, damage your property, or harm your family to scare you or force you to act against your will.
purpose: Protects individual mental peace, liberty, and physical safety against threats.
punishment: Basic threats: imprisonment up to 2 years, or fine, or both. Threats of death, grievous hurt, destruction of property by fire, or imputing unchastity to a woman (aggravated): up to 7 years, or fine, or both. A further 2 years may be added if the threat was made anonymously.
relevant_documents: Audio/video evidence of the threats, exported chat logs with metadata, FIR copy.
key_elements:
Threat of injury to person, reputation, or property.
Intent to cause alarm or force the person to act against their will.
relevant_information:
Audio recordings, text messages, or letters containing threats.
Details of any prior dispute or context.
Eyewitnesses present during the incident.

title: Voluntarily Causing Hurt
legal_text: Whoever does any act with the intention of thereby causing hurt to any person, or with the knowledge that he is likely thereby to cause hurt to any person, and does thereby cause hurt to any person, is said to 'voluntarily cause hurt'.
simple_explanation: When someone intentionally punches, slaps, kicks, or physically hits you and causes bodily pain or injury, it is treated as voluntarily causing hurt.
purpose: Protects bodily integrity and penalizes physical violence.
punishment: Imprisonment of either description for a term up to 1 year, or fine up to Rs. 10,000, or both.
relevant_documents: Medico-legal case (MLC) report, doctor's prescription/treatment bill, photographs of injuries, FIR.
key_elements:
Bodily pain, disease, or infirmity caused.
Intention to cause hurt, or knowledge that the act is likely to cause hurt.
relevant_information:
Time and place of the assault.
Names of witnesses present.
Whether weapons or objects were used (which may elevate the offence).
keywords: assault, hurt, beaten, injury, fight, physical violence, bns 115

title: Defamation
legal_text: Whoever, by words either spoken or intended to be read, or by signs or by visible representations, makes or publishes any imputation concerning any person intending to harm, or knowing or having reason to believe that such imputation will harm, the reputation of such person, is said to defame that person.
simple_explanation: When someone publicly spreads false, harmful statements or posts about you, knowing it will damage your reputation.
purpose: Safeguards an individual's dignity, social standing, and reputation.
punishment: Simple imprisonment up to 2 years, or fine, or both, or community service. The offence is non-cognizable and bailable, generally triable by a Magistrate of the first class.
relevant_documents: Screenshots of posts with URLs/timestamps, legal notice demanding retraction, witness affidavits.
key_elements:
Making or publishing an imputation.
The imputation concerns the aggrieved person.
Intention or knowledge that it will harm reputation.
Does not fall under a recognized legal exception (e.g. truth for public good).
relevant_information:
Exact words, audio, video, or publication used.
Proof that the publication reached third parties.
Evidence disproving the false claims.

title: Assault or Criminal Force to Woman with Intent to Outrage her Modesty
legal_text: Whoever assaults or uses criminal force to any woman, intending to outrage or knowing it to be likely that he will thereby outrage her modesty, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which shall not be less than one year but which may extend to five years, and shall also be liable to fine.

punishment: Imprisonment of either description, not less than 1 year and up to 5 years, and fine. Cognizable and non-bailable.

Intention to outrage her modesty, or knowledge that it is likely to do so.

title: Protection of Life and Personal Liberty
legal_text: No person shall be deprived of his life or personal liberty except according to procedure established by law.
simple_explanation: Every person — citizen or not — has the fundamental right not to be deprived of life or personal liberty, except through a fair legal process. Courts have interpreted this broadly to include rights to dignity, privacy, livelihood, a clean environment, and health.
purpose: Guarantees the fundamental right to life and personal liberty against arbitrary state action.
punishment: Not a penal provision — remedies are constitutional, via a writ petition under Article 32 (Supreme Court) or Article 226 (High Court).
relevant_documents: Writ petition, evidence of the rights violation.
source_name: India Code — Ministry of Law & Justice, Govt. of India
simple_explanation_te: యజమాని సమ్మతి లేకుండా వారి ఆధీనంలో ఉన్న చరాస్తిని (ఫోన్, నగదు, వాహనం, నగలు) నిజాయితీ లేని ఉద్దేశంతో తీసుకోవడం దొంగతనం అవుతుంది. పాత IPC 379 స్థానంలో ఇది వచ్చింది.

example_situation: Suppose an authority locks down an individual's residence and detains them without any formal order, charge sheet, statutory notice, or statutory authority under the law.
example_situation_te: ఒక వ్యక్తిని ఎటువంటి అధికారిక ఉత్తర్వులు, ఎఫ్ఐఆర్, చట్టబద్ధమైన నోటీసు లేకుండా అధికారులు అక్రమంగా నిర్బంధించారని అనుకుందాం.
example_situation_hi: मान लीजिए किसी व्यक्ति को बिना किसी आधिकारिक आदेश, एफआईआर या वैधानिक नोटिस के अवैध रूप से हिरासत में रखा जाता है।
example_explanation: Such unlawful detention violates the core constitutional guarantee of personal liberty under Article 21. The individual or their relatives can seek an immediate Writ of Habeas Corpus before the High Court (Article 226) or Supreme Court (Article 32) to secure release.
example_explanation_te: ఇటువంటి అక్రమ నిర్బంధం ఆర్టికల్ 21 క్రింద వ్యక్తిగత స్వేచ్ఛకు భంగం కలిగిస్తుంది. బాధితుడు లేదా వారి బంధువులు హైకోర్టు (ఆర్టికల్ 226) లేదా సుప్రీంకోర్టు (ఆర్టికల్ 32) లో హెబియస్ కార్పస్ రిట్ పిటిషన్ దాఖలు చేయవచ్చు.
example_explanation_hi: यह अवैध हिरासत अनुच्छेद 21 के तहत व्यक्तिगत स्वतंत्रता का सीधा उल्लंघन है। इसके खिलाफ उच्च न्यायालय (अनुच्छेद 226) या उच्चतम न्यायालय (अनुच्छेद 32) में बंदी प्रत्यक्षीकरण (Habeas Corpus) याचिका दायर की जा सकती है।
example_disclaimer: Fictional educational example. This scenario is provided only to help explain the legal concept and does not represent an actual case.
visual_caption: Constitutional due process safeguards, fair procedure requirements, and judicial remedies under Article 21.
what_you_should_do: Assert your fundamental right to life, dignity, legal counsel, and fair trial against any unlawful state restraint. Seek urgent Habeas Corpus or judicial remedy if liberty is infringed.
what_you_should_do_te: చట్టవిరుద్ధ నిర్బంధానికి వ్యతిరేకంగా జీవించే హక్కు, గౌరవం, న్యాయవాది సహాయం పొందే హక్కును వినియోగించండి. స్వేచ్ఛ ఉల్లంఘించబడితే హేబియస్ కార్పస్ పిటిషన్ వేయండి.

title: Equality Before Law
legal_text: The State shall not deny to any person equality before the law or the equal protection of the laws within the territory of India.
simple_explanation: The government cannot deny any person — citizen, foreign national, or company — either 'equality before the law' or 'the equal protection of the laws.' In practice: no one, including the State itself, is above the law; and people who are truly alike in similar situations must be treated alike, though the State may treat genuinely different groups differently if the distinction is real and logically connected to the law's purpose. Courts have also held that arbitrary government action by itself can violate this article, even without needing to show unequal treatment between two people.
purpose: Guarantees that everyone within India's territory is equally subject to the law and entitled to equal treatment under it, and forbids arbitrary state action.
punishment: Not a penal provision — remedies are constitutional, via a writ petition under Article 32 (Supreme Court) or Article 226 (High Court).
relevant_documents: Writ petition, evidence of the differential or arbitrary treatment.
key_elements:
Applies to any person within India's territory — citizens, non-citizens, and companies alike.
Equality before law: no one, including the State, is above the ordinary law.
Equal protection of the laws: equals must be treated alike, but the State may classify people differently if the classification has an intelligible differentia with a rational nexus to the law's object (the 'reasonable classification' test).
Arbitrary or unreasonable state action can itself be struck down under this article, independent of any comparison to another group.
relevant_information:
Whether the classification or rule being challenged has a real, sensible basis connected to its stated purpose.
Whether the state action was arbitrary or lacked any rational justification.
Whether a more specific right (e.g. Articles 15 or 16, which bar discrimination on specific grounds) applies more directly to the situation.
keywords: equality, article 14, equal protection, reasonable classification, arbitrary state action, discrimination, constitution
source_name: India Code — Ministry of Law & Justice, Govt. of India
simple_explanation_te: భారత భూభాగంలో ఏ వ్యక్తైనా చట్టం ముందు సమానుడే. మతం, జాతి, కులం, లింగం లేదా జన్మస్థలం ఆధారంగా ప్రభుత్వం ఎవరిపైనా వివక్ష చూపకూడదు.
purpose_te: భారతదేశ భూభాగంలో ఉన్న ప్రతి ఒక్కరూ చట్టానికి సమానంగా లోబడి ఉండాలని మరియు దాని కింద సమాన ప్రవర్తనకు అర్హులని హామీ ఇస్తుంది, మరియు ఏకపక్ష రాజ్య చర్యను నిషేధిస్తుంది.
punishment_te: రాజ్యాంగ నిబంధన — వివక్షాపూరిత చట్టాలు లేదా ప్రభుత్వ చర్యలను న్యాయస్థానాలు కొట్టివేస్తాయి.
key_elements_te:
భారతదేశ భూభాగంలో ఉన్న ఏ వ్యక్తికైనా వర్తిస్తుంది — పౌరులు, పౌరులు కానివారు మరియు కంపెనీలు అందరికీ సమానంగా.
చట్టం ముందు సమానత్వం: ప్రభుత్వంతో సహా ఎవరూ సాధారణ చట్టానికి అతీతులు కారు.
చట్టాల సమాన రక్షణ: సమానులను సమానంగా చూడాలి, కానీ వర్గీకరణకు స్పష్టమైన ప్రాతిపదిక మరియు చట్టం లక్ష్యానికి తార్కిక సంబంధం ఉంటే ప్రభుత్వం వేర్వేరు వర్గాలను వేర్వేరుగా వర్గీకరించవచ్చు ('సహేతుక వర్గీకరణ' పరీక్ష).
ఏకపక్ష లేదా అసమంజసమైన రాజ్య చర్యను, మరొక సమూహంతో పోల్చకుండానే, ఈ ఆర్టికల్ కింద కొట్టివేయవచ్చు.
relevant_information_te:
సవాలు చేయబడుతున్న వర్గీకరణ లేదా నియమానికి దాని ప్రకటిత ఉద్దేశ్యానికి సంబంధించిన నిజమైన, సహేతుకమైన ప్రాతిపదిక ఉందా.
రాజ్య చర్య ఏకపక్షంగా ఉందా లేదా హేతుబద్ధమైన సమర్థన లేకుండా ఉందా.
ఈ పరిస్థితికి మరింత నేరుగా వర్తించే మరింత నిర్దిష్టమైన హక్కు (ఉదా. ఆర్టికల్ 15 లేదా 16) ఉందా.
relevant_documents_te: రిట్ పిటిషన్, వ్యత్యాసమైన లేదా ఏకపక్ష ప్రవర్తనకు సంబంధించిన ఆధారాలు.
title_hi: विधि के समक्ष समानता
simple_explanation_hi: भारत के राज्यक्षेत्र में राज्य किसी भी व्यक्ति को कानून के समक्ष समानता या कानूनों के समान संरक्षण से वंचित नहीं करेगा।
punishment_hi: संवैधानिक प्रावधान — मनमाने और भेदभावपूर्ण सरकारी आदेशों को न्यायालय द्वारा निरस्त किया जाता है।
example_title: Scenario: Understanding Equality Before Law
example_title_te: పరిస్థితి: చట్టం ముందు సమానత్వం అవగాహన
example_title_hi: परिदृश्य: विधि के समक्ष समानता को समझें
example_situation: Suppose a citizen encounters a situation where issues relating to equality before law arise under Constitution of India.
example_situation_te: ఒక పౌరుడు చట్టం ముందు సమానత్వం కి సంబంధించిన చట్టపరమైన సమస్యను ఎదుర్కొన్నారని అనుకుందాం.
example_situation_hi: मान लीजिए किसी नागरिक के समक्ष विधि के समक्ष समानता से संबंधित कानूनी स्थिति उत्पन्न होती है।
example_explanation: In such a situation, Article 14 governs the applicable statutory rights, procedures, or liabilities as set out under the law.
example_explanation_te: ఇటువంటి సందర్భంలో, Article 14 ప్రకారం చట్టబద్ధమైన హక్కులు లేదా బాధ్యతలు వర్తిస్తాయి.
example_explanation_hi: ऐसी स्थिति में, Article 14 के तहत लागू कानूनी अधिकार या दायित्व तय किए जाते हैं।
example_disclaimer: Fictional educational example. This scenario is provided only to help explain the legal concept and does not represent an actual case.
what_you_should_do: If state action or law discriminates arbitrarily without reasonable classification, file a Writ Petition under Article 226 before the High Court or Article 32 before the Supreme Court.
what_you_should_do_te: ప్రభుత్వ చర్య సహేతుక వర్గీకరణ లేకుండా ఏకపక్షంగా వివక్ష చూపితే, హైకోర్టులో ఆర్టికల్ 226 లేదా సుప్రీంకోర్టులో ఆర్టికల్ 32 కింద రిట్ పిటిషన్ దాఖలు చేయండి.
what_you_should_do_hi: यदि राज्य की कोई कार्रवाई बिना किसी उचित वर्गीकरण के मनमाने ढंग से भेदभाव करती है, तो उच्च न्यायालय में अनुच्छेद 226 या सर्वोच्च न्यायालय में अनुच्छेद 32 के तहत रिट याचिका दायर करें।

title: Protection of Certain Rights Regarding Freedom of Speech and Expression
legal_text: All citizens shall have the right to freedom of speech and expression. Nothing in sub-clause (a) of clause (1) shall affect the operation of any existing law, or prevent the State from making any law, in so far as such law imposes reasonable restrictions on the exercise of the right conferred by the said sub-clause in the interests of the sovereignty and integrity of India, the security of the State, friendly relations with foreign States, public order, decency or morality or in relation to contempt of court, defamation or incitement to an offence.
simple_explanation: ('Every citizen has the constitutional freedom to express opinions, speak, write, publish news, and criticize government policies peacefully. The State can only restrict this right on strict, narrow grounds specified in Article 19(2) (such as national security, sovereignty, public order, or decency).',)
purpose: Foundational pillar of Indian democracy ensuring free dissemination of ideas and press freedom.
punishment: Unconstitutional censorship or unlawful arrest violates Fundamental Rights; damages/writs grantable by Constitutional Courts.
relevant_documents:
Published text / video / speech transcript
Impugned government order or notice
Writ petition under Article 226/32
key_elements:
Citizen of India
Right to express thoughts by words, writing, printing, or media
Includes freedom of press and right to circulate
Subject only to reasonable restrictions under Article 19(2)
amendment_info: Amended by the Constitution (First Amendment) Act, 1951 and Sixteenth Amendment Act, 1963.
source_name: India Code — Ministry of Law & Justice, Govt. of India
title_te: వాక్ మరియు భావ ప్రకటన స్వేచ్ఛ హక్కు రక్షణ
simple_explanation_te: ('ప్రతి పౌరుడికి మాట్లాడే, రాసే, అభిప్రాయాలను వ్యక్తం చేసే మరియు శాంతియుతంగా ప్రభుత్వాన్ని ప్రశ్నించే ప్రాథమిక రాజ్యాంగ హక్కు ఉంది. దేశ భద్రత, సార్వభౌమాధికారం మరియు శాంతిభద్రతల వంటి పరిమిత కారణాలపై మాత్రమే సహేతుకమైన ఆంక్షలు విధించవచ్చు.',)
purpose_te: భారత ప్రజాస్వామ్యానికి పునాది అయిన భావ వ్యక్తీకరణ మరియు పత్రికా స్వేచ్ఛను పరిరక్షించడం.
punishment_te: చట్టవిరుద్ధమైన సెన్సార్‌షిప్ లేదా అరెస్టు ప్రాథమిక హక్కులను ఉల్లంఘిస్తుంది; కోర్టులు రక్షణ కల్పిస్తాయి.
key_elements_te:
భారత పౌరసత్వం
మాటలు, రచనలు, ప్రింటింగ్ ద్వారా భావ వ్యక్తీకరణ
పత్రికా స్వేచ్ఛను కలిగి ఉంటుంది
ఆర్టికల్ 19(2) పరిమితులకు లోబడి ఉంటుంది
relevant_documents_te:
ప్రచురించిన వ్యాసం లేదా వీడియో కాపీ
ప్రభుత్వ నిషేధ ఉత్తర్వు
రిట్ పిటిషన్ పత్రాలు
title_hi: वाक्-स्वातंत्र्य और अभिव्यक्ति की स्वतंत्रता का अधिकार
simple_explanation_hi: ('प्रत्येक नागरिक को अपने विचार व्यक्त करने, बोलने, लिखने और शांतिपूर्ण ढंग से सरकारी नीतियों की आलोचना करने की संवैधानिक स्वतंत्रता है। राज्य केवल अनुच्छेद 19(2) में दिए गए सीमित आधारों (जैसे राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा, लोक व्यवस्था) पर ही उचित प्रतिबंध लगा सकता है।',)
purpose_hi: भारतीय लोकतंत्र के मूल स्तंभ के रूप में विचार अभिव्यक्ति और प्रेस की स्वतंत्रता सुनिश्चित करना।
punishment_hi: असंवैधानिक रोक या अवैध गिरफ्तारी मौलिक अधिकारों का उल्लंघन है; संवैधानिक अदालतें राहत प्रदान करती हैं।
key_elements_hi:
भारतीय नागरिक
शब्दों, लेखन या मीडिया द्वारा अभिव्यक्ति
प्रेस की स्वतंत्रता शामिल
अनुच्छेद 19(2) के उचित प्रतिबंधों के अधीन
relevant_documents_hi:
प्रकाशित लेख या वीडियो
सरकारी रोक आदेश की प्रति
रिट याचिका दस्तावेज
quick_answer: Yes, Article 19(1)(a) protects freedom of speech and expression, subject only to reasonable restrictions.
quick_answer_te: అవును, ఆర్టికల్ 19(1)(a) వాక్ మరియు భావ ప్రకటన స్వేచ్ఛకు రాజ్యాంగ రక్షణ కల్పిస్తుంది.
quick_answer_hi: हाँ, अनुच्छेद 19(1)(a) वाक् और अभिव्यक्ति की स्वतंत्रता की गारंटी देता है।
example_title: Citizen blogging peaceful criticism of local road infrastructure
example_title_te: రోడ్ల పరిస్థితిపై పౌరుడి శాంతియుత విమర్శల బ్లాగ్
example_title_hi: खराब सड़कों पर नागरिक द्वारा शांतिपूर्ण ब्लॉग लेखन
example_situation: An engineer wrote a well-researched blog showing substandard road construction by the local municipality. A local officer threatened him with a criminal complaint for defaming the department.
example_situation_te: ఒక ఇంజనీర్ స్థానిక మున్సిపల్ రోడ్ల నాణ్యత లోపంపై బ్లాగ్‌లో రాశాడు. డిపార్ట్‌మెంట్‌పై దుష్ప్రచారం చేశాడని అధికారి కేసు పెడతానని బెదిరించాడు.
example_situation_hi: एक नागरिक ने नगर पालिका द्वारा बनाई गई घटिया सड़क का फोटो सहित ब्लॉग लिखा। अधिकारी ने मानहानि का मुकदमा दर्ज करने की धमकी दी।
example_explanation: Under Article 19(1)(a), peaceful, truthful critique of public works is protected speech in the public interest. The High Court protects citizens against frivolous intimidation.
example_explanation_te: ఆర్టికల్ 19(1)(a) ప్రకారం ప్రభుత్వ పనులపై ప్రజా ప్రయోజనార్థం చేసే నిజమైన విమర్శ రక్షించబడుతుంది. తప్పుడు కేసులను కోర్టులు కొట్టివేస్తాయి.
example_explanation_hi: अनुच्छेद 19(1)(a) के तहत जनहित में की गई तथ्यात्मक आलोचना पूरी तरह संरक्षित है। अधिकारी की धमकी गैरकानूनी है।
example_disclaimer: Fictional educational example illustrating Article 19(1)(a) protections.
what_you_should_do: Exercise speech responsibly without inciting violence or hate speech. If a police complaint or gag order is issued without lawful grounds, approach High Court under Article 226 to quash the order.
what_you_should_do_te: బాధ్యతాయుతంగా భావ ప్రకటనా స్వేచ్ఛను వినియోగించండి. చట్టవిరుద్ధంగా నోటీసులు లేదా ఆంక్షలు విధిస్తే హైకోర్టులో ఆర్టికల్ 226 కింద సవాలు చేయండి.
what_you_should_do_hi: हिंसा या घृणा भाषण को बढ़ावा दिए बिना जिम्मेदारी से अपने विचार व्यक्त करें। अनुचित प्रतिबंध लगने पर उच्च न्यायालय में अनुच्छेद 226 के तहत चुनौती दें।

title: Remedies for Enforcement of Fundamental Rights (Constitutional Writs)
legal_text: The right to move the Supreme Court by appropriate proceedings for the enforcement of the rights conferred by this Part is guaranteed. The Supreme Court shall have power to issue directions or orders or writs, including writs in the nature of habeas corpus, mandamus, prohibition, quo warranto and certiorari, whichever may be appropriate, for the enforcement of any of the rights conferred by this Part.
simple_explanation: ("Article 32 is called the 'Heart and Soul of the Constitution' (Dr. B.R. Ambedkar). It gives every citizen the direct right to approach the Supreme Court of India if any of their Fundamental Rights are violated. The Court can issue 5 powerful Writs: Habeas Corpus (release illegal detainee), Mandamus (order public official to perform duty), Certiorari (quash unlawful order), Prohibition, and Quo Warranto.",)
purpose: Guarantees direct constitutional remedies from the highest court of the land against fundamental rights violations.
punishment: Contempt of Supreme Court for disobedience of writ orders is punishable with fine and imprisonment under Article 129.
relevant_documents:
Writ Petition under Article 32
Affidavit verifying facts
Copies of unlawful orders / proof of rights infringement
key_elements:
Direct remedy before Supreme Court
Enforcement of Fundamental Rights (Part III)
Five prerogative writs
Cannot be suspended except under emergency
amendment_info: Basic structure of the Constitution; cannot be curtailed even by constitutional amendment.
source_name: India Code — Ministry of Law & Justice, Govt. of India
title_te: ప్రాథమిక హక్కుల అమలు కోసం పరిహారాలు (రాజ్యాంగ రిట్లు)
simple_explanation_te: ("ఆర్టికల్ 32 భారత రాజ్యాంగానికి 'హృదయం మరియు ఆత్మ' వంటిది. పౌరుల ప్రాథమిక హక్కులు ఉల్లంఘించబడినప్పుడు నేరుగా సుప్రీంకోర్టును ఆశ్రయించే హక్కును ఇది కల్పిస్తుంది. సుప్రీంకోర్టు 5 రకాల రిట్లను జారీ చేయగలదు: హేబియస్ కార్పస్, మాండమస్, సెర్టియోరారి, ప్రొహిబిషన్, కో-వారంటో.",)

simple_explanation_hi: ("अनुच्छेद 32 को डॉ. बी.आर. आंबेडकर ने 'संविधान की आत्मा और हृदय' कहा था। यह नागरिकों को अपने मौलिक अधिकारों के हनन पर सीधे सर्वोच्च न्यायालय जाने का अधिकार देता है। न्यायालय 5 प्रकार की रिट जारी कर सकता है: बंदी प्रत्यक्षीकरण, परमादेश, प्रतिषेध, उत्प्रेषण और अधिकार-पृच्छा।",)

title: Person Arrested to be Informed of Grounds of Arrest and of Right to Bail
legal_text: Every police officer or other person arresting any person without warrant shall forthwith communicate to him full particulars of the offence for which he is arrested or other grounds for such arrest. Where a police officer arrests without warrant any person other than a person accused of a non-bailable offence, he shall inform the person arrested that he is entitled to be released on bail and that he may arrange for sureties.
simple_explanation: If you're arrested, the police must immediately tell you why you're being arrested — and if it's for a bailable offence, they must tell you you're entitled to bail.
purpose: Prevents arbitrary arrest by requiring the reason to be stated immediately, upholding Article 22.
punishment: Not a penal provision — a procedural safeguard; non-compliance can render an arrest illegal and support release via habeas corpus.
relevant_documents: Arrest memo stating the grounds, bail application, surety identification documents.
key_elements:
Immediate communication of specific allegations and section numbers.
Information regarding the bailable nature of the alleged offence (for bailable offences only).
Right to arrange sureties if the offence is bailable.
relevant_information:
Whether the offence is classified as bailable or non-bailable.
Name and badge number of the arresting officer.

example_title_hi: परिदृश्य: जमानती अपराध में गिरफ्तारी
example_situation: Suppose a citizen is detained without warrant by police during a public gathering for an alleged bailable infraction, but the arresting officer does not inform the citizen of the specific grounds of arrest or whether the alleged offence is bailable.
example_situation_te: శాంతియుతంగా నిరసన తెలుపుతున్న ఒక పౌరుడిని చిన్న బెయిలబుల్ నేరం కింద పోలీసులు అరెస్ట్ చేశారని అనుకుందాం. ఎందుకు అరెస్ట్ చేశారో చెప్పకుండా, బెయిల్ హక్కు గురించి కూడా తెలపలేదు.
example_situation_hi: मान लीजिए पुलिस किसी व्यक्ति को जमानती अपराध में गिरफ्तार करती है, लेकिन गिरफ्तारी का कारण नहीं बताती और न ही थाने से जमानत मिलने के अधिकार की जानकारी देती है।
example_explanation: Under Section 47 of BNSS 2023, the arresting officer is statutorily required to forthwith communicate full particulars of the offence or grounds of arrest. Where the alleged offence is bailable, the officer must also inform the person of their entitlement to bail so they may arrange sureties. In this scenario, failure to inform the arrestee of these statutory particulars raises a procedural non-compliance issue under Section 47. Depending on the surrounding facts, the arrestee may lawfully request clarification of the charges, ask whether the offence is bailable, request that an arrest memo be prepared, and arrange sureties to seek station bail where permitted by law.
example_explanation_te: BNSS సెక్షన్ 47 ప్రకారం, కారణాలు మరియు బెయిల్ హక్కును దాచడం చట్టవిరుద్ధం. అరెస్ట్ అయిన వ్యక్తి కారణాలను లిఖితపూర్వకంగా అడిగే హక్కును కలిగి ఉంటారు మరియు పోలీస్ స్టేషన్‌లోనే బెయిల్ దరఖాస్తు చేసుకోవచ్చు.
example_explanation_hi: बीएनएसएस धारा 47 के तहत कारण और जमानत के अधिकार को छिपाना गैरकानूनी है। गिरफ्तार व्यक्ति को लिखित कारण जानने और थाने में जमानत मांगने का पूरा कानूनी अधिकार है।

what_you_should_do:
1. Politely ask the arresting officer: 'Under what section and grounds am I being arrested?'
2. Inquire whether the alleged offence is bailable or non-bailable under the First Schedule of BNSS.
3. Request the preparation of an arrest memo recording the time, location, and witness signature (BNSS Section 46).
4. If bailable, request the opportunity to arrange solvent sureties for release on station bail.
5. Request that a nominated relative or friend be informed of the arrest and place of custody (BNSS Section 48).
what_you_should_do_te:
1. 'నన్ను ఏ సెక్షన్ మరియు ఏ కారణంతో అరెస్ట్ చేస్తున్నారు?' అని పోలీసులను మర్యాదగా అడగండి.
2. ఇది బెయిలబుల్ నేరమా కాదా అని నిర్ధారించుకోండి.
3. తేదీ, సమయం, సాక్షి సంతకంతో కూడిన అరెస్ట్ మెమోను డిమాండ్ చేయండి.
4. బెయిలబుల్ అయితే, స్టేషన్ లోనే బెయిల్ పొందడానికి పూచీకత్తును ఏర్పాటు చేసుకోండి.
what_you_should_do_hi:
1. पुलिस अधिकारी से शांतिपूर्वक पूछें: 'मुझे किस धारा और आरोप में गिरफ्तार किया जा रहा है?'
2. यह पता करें कि अपराध जमानती है या गैर-जमानती।
3. समय, स्थान और गवाह के हस्ताक्षर वाला अरेस्ट मेमो मांगें।
4. यदि अपराध जमानती है, तो थाने से ही जमानत पाने के लिए जमानती की व्यवस्था करें।

title: Right to Inform a Relative or Friend of the Arrest
legal_text: The police officer or person making the arrest shall forthwith give information regarding the arrest and the place where the arrested person is being held, to a relative, friend, or other person nominated by the arrested person for that purpose.
simple_explanation: You have the right to have the police tell someone you choose — a relative or friend — that you've been arrested and where you're being held.
purpose: Ensures the arrested person is not held incommunicado.
punishment: Not a penal provision — a procedural safeguard for the arrested person.
relevant_documents: Arrest memo naming the informed person.
source: Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (Act No. 46 of 2023), Government of India — replaced the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 from 1 July 2024. title: Restriction on Arrest of Women After Sunset
legal_text: As a general rule, no woman shall be arrested after sunset and before sunrise. Where exceptional circumstances exist, a woman police officer must obtain prior written permission of a Magistrate of the First Class within whose local jurisdiction the offence is committed or the arrest is to be made.
simple_explanation: Ordinarily, a woman cannot be arrested at night. If there's an exceptional reason to do so, it must be a woman police officer making the arrest, with a magistrate's prior written permission.
purpose: Protects women from arrest procedures at night absent exceptional justification.
punishment: Not a penal provision — a procedural safeguard for women being arrested.
relevant_documents: Magistrate's written permission (in exceptional cases).

title: Production Before a Magistrate Within 24 Hours
legal_text: No police officer shall detain a person arrested without a warrant in custody for a period longer than is reasonable, and such period shall not exceed twenty-four hours, excluding the time necessary for travel from the place of arrest to the Magistrate's court, without a special order of a Magistrate. Every arrested person shall be produced before the nearest Magistrate within that 24-hour period.
simple_explanation: The police can't hold you for more than 24 hours (not counting travel time to court) without a magistrate's order — you must be produced before a magistrate within that time.
purpose: Prevents indefinite detention without judicial oversight.
punishment: Not a penal provision — a procedural safeguard for the arrested person.
relevant_documents: Remand order, production record.

title: Right to Consult and Be Defended by a Legal Practitioner
legal_text: No person who is arrested shall be detained in custody without being informed, as soon as may be, of the grounds for such arrest nor shall he be denied the right to consult, and to be defended by, a legal practitioner of his choice.
simple_explanation: You have the constitutional right to consult a lawyer of your choice and be defended by them. If you can't afford one, the Supreme Court (Hussainara Khatoon v. State of Bihar, 1980) held the state must provide free legal aid — see the Legal Help section of this app for the NALSA helpline.
purpose: Guarantees access to legal representation as a fundamental right.
punishment: Not a penal provision — a fundamental constitutional right.
relevant_documents: None required to exercise this right.

title: When Police May Arrest Without Warrant
legal_text: A police officer may arrest a person without an order from a Magistrate and without a warrant where a cognizable offence is committed in their presence, or on credible information/reasonable suspicion. For offences punishable with less than seven years' imprisonment, the officer must additionally believe arrest is necessary for a specified purpose (preventing further offence, ensuring proper investigation, preventing evidence tampering, etc.) and must record reasons in writing — both when making, and when choosing not to make, the arrest.
simple_explanation: Explains when police can arrest someone without a magistrate's warrant. For offences carrying under 7 years, arrest is meant to be the exception: the officer must normally issue a notice to appear instead, unless there's a specific, recorded reason arrest is necessary.
purpose: Balances law-enforcement power with constitutional rights against arbitrary detention.
punishment: Not a penal provision — a procedural safeguard governing when and how police may arrest.
relevant_documents: Copy of arrest memo, copy of FIR/complaint, intimation memo sent to family/nominated person.
key_elements:
Cognizable offence committed in the presence of the police officer.
Reasonable complaint or credible information for offences with prescribed punishments.
For offences under 7 years: a notice of appearance is ordinarily issued instead of arrest.
Mandatory recording of reasons in writing, whether or not an arrest is made.
relevant_information:
Did the officer inform the arrested person of the exact grounds of arrest?
Was an arrest memo prepared with date, time, and witness signature?
Was a family member or friend informed immediately?
keywords: arrest, police, custody, warrant, grounds of arrest, rights, bnss 35
source: Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, Section 35. Cross-verified against indiankanoon.org, drishtijudiciary.com, leadindia.law, and vaishlaw.com.

అరెస్టు చేసినా, చేయకపోయినా కారణాలను తప్పనిసరిగా వ్రాతపూర్వకంగా నమోదు చేయాలి.

తేదీ, సమయం, సాక్షి సంతకంతో అరెస్టు మెమో తయారు చేశారా?
కుటుంబ సభ్యుడు లేదా స్నేహితుడికి వెంటనే తెలియజేశారా?

title: Cheating by Personation by Using Computer Resource
legal_text: Whoever, by means of any communication device or computer resource cheats by personation, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years and shall also be liable to fine which may extend to one lakh rupees.
simple_explanation: If someone creates a fake identity online (pretending to be a bank official, army officer, or friend) over a call, message, or website to trick you into transferring money or sharing your OTP/credentials, this is the applicable offence.
purpose: Combats digital impersonation, phishing attacks, and online financial fraud.
punishment: Imprisonment of either description up to 3 years, and fine up to Rs. 1,00,000.
relevant_documents: National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal complaint receipt, bank statement, screenshots of SMS/OTP requests and chats.
key_elements:
Use of a computer resource or communication device.
Deception by pretending to be someone else.
Cheating and dishonest inducement.
relevant_information:
Transaction ID, UTR number, beneficiary account details.
Phone numbers, emails, or website links used by the fraudster.
Acknowledgement number from cybercrime.gov.in (Helpline 1930).
keywords: cyber fraud, online scam, phishing, fake profile, otp fraud, impersonation, it act 66d

title: Punishment for Identity Theft
legal_text: Whoever, fraudulently or dishonestly make use of the electronic signature, password or any other unique identification feature of any other person, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years and shall also be liable to fine which may extend to rupees one lakh.
simple_explanation: If someone steals your email password, social media login, UPI PIN, or digital signature and uses it without your permission, they can be prosecuted under this section.
purpose: Safeguards digital identities, passwords, and electronic credentials.
punishment: Imprisonment of either description up to 3 years, and fine up to Rs. 1,00,000.
relevant_documents: Security alert emails, screenshots of unauthorized account changes, cyber police complaint copy.
key_elements:
Unauthorized use of electronic signature, password, or biometric data.
Done dishonestly or fraudulently.
relevant_information:
Access logs and login-alert emails from service providers.
IP address / device information in security logs, if available.
Services accessed without authorization.
keywords: identity theft, password, digital signature, biometric, hacked, stolen credentials, it act 66c

title: Punishment for Violation of Bodily Privacy (Voyeurism & Hidden Cameras)
legal_text: Whoever, intentionally or knowingly captures, publishes or transmits the image of a private area of any person without his or her consent, under circumstances violating the privacy of that person, shall be punished with imprisonment which may extend to three years or with fine not exceeding two lakh rupees, or with both.
simple_explanation: ("Capturing, recording, transmitting, or publishing photos or videos of anyone's private body parts, changing rooms, bathrooms, or intimate moments without their explicit consent (such as hidden cameras in hotel rooms or trial rooms) is a non-bailable cyber offence carrying up to 3 years imprisonment and ₹2,00,000 fine.",)
purpose: Shields citizens against digital voyeurism, spy-cams, and intimate privacy infringements.
punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years, fine up to ₹2,00,000, or both.
relevant_documents:

Complaint copy to Cyber Crime portal (cybercrime.gov.in)

key_elements:
Captures, publishes, or transmits image of private area

Circumstances violating privacy
Imprisonment up to 3 years and fine up to 2 lakhs

title_hi: निजता के उल्लंघन के लिए दंड (हिडन कैमरा और अश्लील तस्वीरें)
simple_explanation_hi: ('किसी भी व्यक्ति की सहमति के बिना उसके निजी अंगों, चेंजिंग रूम, बाथरूम या होटल के कमरे में छिपे कैमरे से फोटो/वीडियो लेना, प्रसारित या प्रकाशित करना गंभीर साइबर अपराध है, जिसमें 3 वर्ष तक की कैद और 2 लाख रुपये तक का जुर्माना हो सकता है।',)
purpose_hi: डिजिटल ताक-झांक, जासूसी कैमरों और व्यक्तिगत निजता के हनन से नागरिकों की रक्षा करना।
punishment_hi: 3 साल तक की जेल, 2 लाख रुपये तक का जुर्माना, या दोनों।

बिना सहमति निजी अंगों की तस्वीर/वीडियो लेना या भेजना
निजता का उल्लंघन
3 साल तक की कैद
2 लाख रुपये तक जुर्माना
relevant_documents_hi:

quick_answer: Yes, planting hidden cameras or capturing private images without consent carries up to 3 years jail and 2 lakh fine.

quick_answer_hi: हाँ, हिडन कैमरा लगाना या बिना सहमति निजी तस्वीरें लेना 3 साल तक की जेल और 2 लाख जुर्माने का अपराध है।
example_title: Hidden pinhole camera found in clothing store trial room
example_title_te: బట్టల దుకాణం ట్రయల్ రూమ్‌లో కనిపించిన దాచిన కెమెరా
example_title_hi: कपड़ों की दुकान के ट्रायल रूम में मिला हिडन कैमरा
example_situation: A customer in a clothing boutique noticed a suspicious blinking wire above the trial room mirror and discovered a mini-camera connected to a laptop in the staff room.
example_situation_te: బట్టల దుకాణం ట్రయల్ రూమ్ అద్దం పైన అనుమానాస్పద వైర్ కనిపించడంతో సిబ్బంది గదిలోని ల్యాప్‌టాప్‌కు కనెక్ట్ చేసిన చిన్న కెమెరా బయటపడింది.
example_situation_hi: एक ग्राहक ने ट्रायल रूम के शीशे के पास एक संदिग्ध कैमरा देखा जो स्टाफ रूम के लैपटॉप से जुड़ा था।
example_explanation: Police seized the devices and arrested the store manager under Section 66E of the IT Act. The court denied bail given the gross infringement of privacy.
example_explanation_te: పోలీసులు పరికరాలను స్వాధీనం చేసుకుని ఐటీ చట్టం సెక్షన్ 66E కింద స్టోర్ మేనేజర్‌ను అరెస్టు చేశారు. గోప్యత ఉల్లంఘన కారణంగా కోర్టు బెయిల్ నిరాకరించింది.
example_explanation_hi: पुलिस ने उपकरण जब्त कर स्टोर मैनेजर को धारा 66E के तहत गिरफ्तार किया। अदालत ने निजता के गंभीर हनन को देखते हुए जमानत खारिज कर दी।
example_disclaimer: Fictional educational scenario demonstrating enforcement of Section 66E IT Act.
what_you_should_do: Do not tamper with the device if you discover a hidden camera in a trial room or hotel. Immediately call 112/police. Take photos of the camera setup and file a complaint under Section 66E IT Act and BNS Section 77.
what_you_should_do_te: ట్రయల్ రూమ్ లేదా హోటల్‌లో రహస్య కెమెరా కనిపిస్తే వెంటనే 112 పోలీసులకు కాల్ చేయండి. కెమెరాను ఫోటో తీసి సెక్షన్ 66E మరియు BNS సెక్షన్ 77 కింద ఎఫ్‌ఐఆర్ నమోదు చేయించండి.
what_you_should_do_hi: ट्रायल रूम या होटल में हिडन कैमरा मिलने पर तुरंत 112/पुलिस को कॉल करें। कैमरे की फोटो लें और धारा 66E आईटी एक्ट तथा बीएनएस धारा 77 के तहत प्राथमिकी दर्ज कराएं।

title: Driving by a Drunken Person or by a Person Under the Influence of Drugs
legal_text: Whoever, while driving, or attempting to drive, a motor vehicle has, in his blood, alcohol exceeding 30 mg per 100 ml of blood detected in a test by a breath analyser, or is under the influence of a drug to such an extent as to be incapable of exercising proper control over the vehicle, shall be punishable.
simple_explanation: Driving any vehicle after drinking alcohol, if a breathalyzer shows alcohol above the legal limit (30mg per 100ml), is an offence punishable with fines and possible jail.
purpose: Prevents road fatalities and discourages driving under substance influence.
punishment: First offence: imprisonment up to 6 months, or fine up to Rs. 10,000, or both. Second or subsequent offence within 3 years: imprisonment up to 2 years, or fine up to Rs. 15,000, or both (figures as increased by the Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2019, effective 1 September 2019).
relevant_documents: E-challan copy, driving license and RC, breathalyzer test reading, vehicle insurance policy.
key_elements:
Driving or attempting to drive a motor vehicle in a public place.
Blood alcohol content exceeding 30 mg/100 ml, or incapable of proper control due to drugs.
relevant_information:
Breath analyser test slip / reading.
Blood sample testing report, if taken.
Challan / impound memo issued by traffic police.
keywords: drunk driving, alcohol, traffic, breathalyzer, fine, driving license, accident, mv act 185
amendment_info: Amended by Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2019 (Act No. 32 of 2019)

simple_explanation_te: శ్వాస పరీక్షలో (బ్రీత్ ఎనలైజర్) 100 మి.లీ రక్తంలో 30 మి.గ్రా కంటే ఎక్కువ ఆల్కహాల్ ఉన్నట్లు తేలితే వాహనం నడపడం తీవ్ర నేరం.
punishment_te: మొదటి నేరానికి: 6 నెలల వరకు జైలు లేదా రూ. 10,000 జరిమానా; రెండవసారి: 2 సంవత్సరాల వరకు జైలు లేదా రూ. 15,000 జరిమానా.
title_hi: शराब या नशीले पदार्थों के प्रभाव में गाड़ी चलाना
simple_explanation_hi: श्वास विश्लेषक परीक्षण में 100 मिली रक्त में 30 मिलीग्राम से अधिक शराब पाए जाने पर वाहन चलाना गंभीर अपराध है।
punishment_hi: पहला अपराध: 6 महीने तक कारावास या 10,000 रुपये जुर्माना; दोबारा करने पर: 2 वर्ष तक कारावास या 15,000 रुपये जुर्माना।
example_title: Scenario: Breath Analyser Traffic Checkpoint
example_title_te: పరిస్థితి: ట్రాఫిక్ బ్రీత్ ఎనలైజర్ తనిఖీ
example_title_hi: परिदृश्य: ट्रैफिक पुलिस ब्रेथ एनालाइजर जांच
example_situation: Suppose a driver consumes multiple alcoholic drinks at a restaurant and drives home. At a lawful traffic stop, a breath analyser test registers 55 mg/100 ml blood alcohol level.
example_situation_te: ఒక డ్రైవర్ ఆల్కహాల్ సేవించి కారు నడుపుతూ ట్రాఫిక్ తనిఖీలో దొరికిపోయాడు. బ్రీత్ ఎనలైజర్ పరీక్షలో 55 మి.గ్రా/100 మి.లీ ఆల్కహాల్ ఉన్నట్లు తేలింది.
example_situation_hi: मान लीजिए एक चालक शराब पीकर वाहन चला रहा है और चेकिंग के दौरान ब्रेथ एनालाइजर में 55 मिलीग्राम प्रति 100 मिली शराब की पुष्टि होती है।
example_explanation: Because the reading exceeds the statutory threshold of 30 mg/100 ml, the driver is liable under Section 185. First offence attracts imprisonment up to 6 months and/or fine up to ₹10,000. Subsequent offences within 3 years attract up to 2 years imprisonment and/or ₹15,000 fine.
example_explanation_te: చట్టబద్ధ పరిమితి 30 మి.గ్రా కంటే ఎక్కువగా ఉన్నందున, సెక్షన్ 185 కింద చర్యలు తీసుకుంటారు. మొదటిసారి నేరానికి 6 నెలల వరకు జైలు లేదా ₹10,000 వరకు జరిమానా, రెండోసారి అయితే 2 సంవత్సరాల వరకు జైలు లేదా ₹15,000 వరకు జరిమానా విధించవచ్చు.
example_explanation_hi: यह कानूनी सीमा (30 मिलीग्राम) से अधिक होने के कारण धारा 185 के तहत अपराध है। पहली बार में 6 महीने तक की जेल या ₹10,000 तक जुर्माना, और दूसरी बार में 2 साल तक की जेल या ₹15,000 जुर्माना हो सकता है।
example_disclaimer: Fictional educational example. This scenario is provided only to help explain the legal concept and does not represent an actual case.

visual_caption_hi: ट्रैफिक चेकपॉइंट ब्रीथ एनालाइज़र सीमा (30mg/100ml) और चालक के अधिकार।

video_transcript: Under Section 185 of the Motor Vehicles Act, driving with blood alcohol exceeding 30 mg per 100 ml is penalised. Police must utilize a calibrated breath analyser and provide a printed slip. Drivers have the right to request a medical blood test verification.

title: Driving Vehicles in Contravention of Section 3 or Section 4 (Driving Without Driving Licence)
legal_text: Whoever drives a motor vehicle in contravention of section 3 or section 4 shall be punishable with imprisonment for a term which may extend to three months, or with fine which may extend to five thousand rupees, or with both.
simple_explanation: ('Driving any motor vehicle without a valid driving license (or allowing an underage person without a license to drive) is a serious offence under the 2019 amendment punishable with a heavy fine up to ₹5,000, imprisonment up to 3 months, or both.',)
purpose: Ensures road safety and prevents unqualified, unlicensed drivers from endangering public life.
punishment: Fine up to ₹5,000, imprisonment up to 3 months, or both.
relevant_documents:
Physical Driving Licence or digital copy on DigiLocker / mParivahan app
Vehicle RC
Insurance policy certificate
key_elements:
Driving motor vehicle on public road
No valid driving licence held
Offence is compoundable by traffic police
Vehicle impoundment possible under Section 207
amendment_info: Fine increased tenfold from ₹500 to ₹5,000 by the Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2019.
source_name: India Code — Ministry of Law & Justice, Govt. of India

example_title: Student caught riding friend's bike without driving licence
example_title_te: డ్రైవింగ్ లైసెన్స్ లేకుండా స్నేహితుడి బైక్ నడుపుతూ పట్టుబడ్డ విద్యార్థి
example_title_hi: बिना लाइसेंस मित्र की बाइक चलाते पकड़ा गया छात्र

example_situation_te: కిరణ్ తన స్నేహితుడి బైక్‌పై బయలుదేరాడు. ట్రాఫిక్ తనిఖీలో డ్రైవింగ్ లైసెన్స్ చూపించలేకపోయాడు.

example_explanation: Traffic police issued a challan for ₹5,000 under Section 181. Under Section 180, his friend who permitted an unlicensed driver to ride was also penalized.
example_explanation_te: ట్రాఫిక్ పోలీసులు సెక్షన్ 181 కింద కిరణ్‌కు రూ. 5,000 చలాన్ విధించారు. లైసెన్స్ లేని వ్యక్తికి బైక్ ఇచ్చిన స్నేహితుడికి కూడా సెక్షన్ 180 కింద జరిమానా విధించారు.

title: Manner in Which Complaint Shall Be Made
legal_text: A complaint may be filed before the District Commission by the consumer to whom the goods/services were sold or provided, or who alleges an unfair trade practice; by a recognized consumer association; by one or more consumers, with the Commission's permission, where numerous consumers have the same interest; or by the Central Government, Central Authority, or a State Government.
simple_explanation: If a company sold you a defective product, refused a rightful refund, or gave poor service, this section explains who can file a case in the District Consumer Commission and how — including electronic filing.
purpose: Provides an accessible mechanism for consumers to seek redress against sellers and service providers.
punishment: Not a penal provision — a procedural provision governing who may file a complaint and how.
relevant_documents: Tax invoice, warranty card copy, written communication with seller, legal notice sent (if any).
key_elements:
Complainant must be a 'consumer' (bought for consideration, not commercial resale).
Defect in goods, deficiency in service, or unfair trade practice.
Complaint (and fee payment) may be filed electronically, per prescribed rules.
relevant_information:
Invoice number, purchase date, and payment proof.
Warranty/guarantee card details.
Customer care complaints, email exchanges, and ticket numbers.
keywords: consumer, defective product, refund, warranty, consumer court, e-commerce fraud, cpa 35
amendment_info: Enacted under Consumer Protection Act, 2019 replacing the 1986 Act with e-commerce and product liability coverage.
source_name: India Code — Ministry of Law & Justice, Govt. of India

simple_explanation_hi: यदि किसी कंपनी ने खराब उत्पाद दिया है या उचित सेवा देने से इनकार किया है, तो उपभोक्ता जिला/राज्य आयोग में या ई-दाखिल पोर्टल पर ऑनलाइन शिकायत दर्ज कर सकते हैं।
punishment_hi: दीवानी उपचार — उत्पाद की मरम्मत, नया उत्पाद, धनवापसी या मानसिक प्रताड़ना के लिए हर्जाना।

example_situation: Suppose a consumer purchases a brand-new television for ₹45,000. Within two days, the screen fails. The manufacturer and authorized service center inspect it, admit hardware defect, but refuse repair, replacement, or refund.

example_explanation: Under CPA Section 35, the consumer can file a complaint before the District Commission (or online via e-Daakhil). The Commission can order refund, replacement, compensation for mental agony, and litigation costs.
example_explanation_te: సెక్షన్ 35 క్రింద, వినియోగదారుడు జిల్లా కమిషన్‌లో (లేదా e-Daakhil పోర్టల్ ద్వారా) ఫిర్యాదు చేయవచ్చు. కమిషన్ పూర్తి రీఫండ్, నష్టపరిహారం మరియు ఖర్చులను ఇప్పించవచ్చు.
example_explanation_hi: धारा 35 के तहत उपभोक्ता जिला आयोग में या e-Daakhil पोर्टल पर ऑनलाइन शिकायत दर्ज कर सकता है। आयोग टीवी बदलने, पूरा पैसा लौटाने और मानसिक प्रताड़ना का मुआवजा देने का आदेश दे सकता है।

title: Grounds for Divorce
legal_text: Either spouse may petition for divorce on grounds including adultery, cruelty, desertion for two or more continuous years, conversion to another religion, unsoundness of mind, communicable venereal disease, renunciation of the world, or not being heard of as alive for seven years. A wife has additional exclusive grounds, including the husband's bigamy, rape, sodomy, or bestiality.
simple_explanation: Lets a husband or wife apply to court for divorce on specific grounds like cruelty, desertion, or adultery. Divorce can also be obtained by mutual consent under a separate provision (Section 13B) without needing to prove fault.
purpose: Provides a legal way to end a broken marriage, balancing marital stability with protection from abuse or injustice.
punishment: Not a penal provision — the remedy is a court decree dissolving the marriage.
relevant_documents: Marriage certificate, divorce petition, evidence supporting the ground claimed (medical records, communication records, witness statements).
key_elements:
Petitioner must be the aggrieved husband or wife.
A specific statutory ground must be proved with evidence.
Desertion must be for a continuous period of two years or more.
A wife has additional exclusive grounds beyond those available to a husband.
relevant_information:
Marriage certificate or proof of a valid Hindu marriage.
Dates and evidence supporting the specific ground claimed.
Whether mutual consent divorce (faster, no-fault) is a realistic option instead.
keywords: divorce, separation, marriage breakdown, cruelty, desertion, adultery, hindu marriage act, section 13
source_name: India Code — Ministry of Law & Justice, Govt. of India
simple_explanation_te: క్రూరత్వం, పరస్త్రీ/పరపురుష సంబంధం, 2 సంవత్సరాలకు పైగా వదిలివెళ్లడం, లేదా మానసిక సమస్యలు వంటి నిర్దిష్ట కారణాల ఆధారంగా భార్య లేదా భర్త కోర్టులో విడాకులకు దరఖాస్తు చేసుకోవచ్చు.
punishment_te: సివిల్ పరిష్కారం — కోర్టు విడాకుల డిక్రీ జారీ చేస్తుంది మరియు భరణం ఖరారు చేస్తుంది.
title_hi: तलाक के आधार (Grounds for Divorce)
simple_explanation_hi: क्रूरता, व्यभिचार, कम से कम 2 वर्ष तक परित्याग या मानसिक विकार जैसे विशिष्ट कानूनी आधारों पर पति या पत्नी द्वारा अदालत में तलाक की याचिका दायर की जा सकती है।
punishment_hi: दीवानी उपाय — अदालत द्वारा विवाह विच्छेद की डिक्री और गुजारा भत्ता का निर्धारण।
example_title: Scenario: Petition Based on Desertion and Cruelty
example_title_te: పరిస్థితి: వదిలివేయడం మరియు క్రూరత్వం ఆధారంగా విడాకుల పిటిషన్
example_title_hi: परिदृश्य: परित्याग और क्रूरता के आधार पर तलाक याचिका
example_situation: Suppose a spouse leaves the matrimonial home without reasonable cause, refuses all communication or cohabitation for more than two continuous years, and subjects the other spouse to persistent verbal and financial harassment.
example_situation_te: ఒక జీవిత భాగస్వామి ఎటువంటి సరైన కారణం లేకుండా రెండేళ్లకు పైగా ఇంటిని వదిలి వెళ్లిపోయి, ఎటువంటి సంబంధం లేకుండా మానసిక వేధింపులకు గురిచేశారని అనుకుందాం.
example_situation_hi: मान लीजिए एक जीवनसाथी बिना किसी वैध कारण के 2 साल से अधिक समय से अलग रह रहा है और दूसरे साथी को मानसिक रूप से प्रताड़ित कर रहा है।
example_explanation: Under Section 13(1)(ib) (desertion for not less than two years) and Section 13(1)(ia) (cruelty), the aggrieved spouse may file a divorce petition before the competent Family Court seeking dissolution of the marriage.
example_explanation_te: సెక్షన్ 13(1) క్రింద వదిలివేయడం (2 ఏళ్లకు పైగా) మరియు క్రూరత్వం ఆధారంగా ఫ్యామిలీ కోర్టులో విడాకుల పిటిషన్ దాఖలు చేయవచ్చు.
example_explanation_hi: धारा 13(1) के तहत परित्याग और क्रूरता के आधार पर सक्षम फैमिली कोर्ट में तलाक की डिक्री के लिए कानूनी याचिका दायर की जा सकती है।
example_disclaimer: Fictional educational example. This scenario is provided only to help explain the legal concept and does not represent an actual case.
what_you_should_do: Consult a matrimonial lawyer. Gather corroborative documentary evidence of statutory grounds (cruelty, desertion, or mutual consent) and file petition in Family Court of competent jurisdiction.
what_you_should_do_te: వైవాహిక న్యాయవాదిని సంప్రదించండి. క్రూరత్వం, విడిచిపెట్టడం లేదా పరస్పర అంగీకారానికి సంబంధించిన ఆధారాలను సేకరించి సరైన ఫ్యామిలీ కోర్టులో పిటిషన్ దాఖలు చేయండి.
what_you_should_do_hi: पारिवारिक वकील से परामर्श लें। वैधानिक आधारों (क्रूरता, परित्याग, या आपसी सहमति) के दस्तावेजी साक्ष्य जुटाएं और अधिकार क्षेत्र वाले पारिवारिक न्यायालय में याचिका दायर करें।

law_name: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005
title: Application to Magistrate for Protection and Other Orders
legal_text: An aggrieved person, a Protection Officer, or another person on her behalf may apply to the Magistrate for one or more reliefs under the Act. The Magistrate must consider any Domestic Incident Report before deciding, must ordinarily hold the first hearing within three days of the application being filed, and should endeavour to dispose of the application within sixty days of the first hearing.
simple_explanation: Lets a woman facing domestic violence go directly to a Magistrate for protection, residence, monetary relief, custody, or compensation orders — a fast civil remedy separate from filing a criminal case.
purpose: Creates an accessible, time-bound civil remedy against domestic violence, independent of criminal prosecution.
punishment: Not a penal provision — the Magistrate can pass protection, residence, monetary relief, custody, and compensation orders under related sections of the Act.
relevant_documents: Domestic Incident Report, application under Section 12, medical/police records of incidents, proof of shared household or marriage.
key_elements:
Applicant must be an 'aggrieved person' in a domestic relationship facing violence.
Application can be filed by her, a Protection Officer, or someone on her behalf.
Magistrate considers the Domestic Incident Report before deciding.
First hearing is meant to be held within 3 days; disposal targeted within 60 days.
relevant_information:
Proof of the domestic relationship (marriage certificate, shared household proof).
A documented timeline of incidents — photos, medical records, messages, police reports.
Whether a Domestic Incident Report has already been filed with a Protection Officer.
keywords: domestic violence, protection order, magistrate application, dv act, section 12, abuse complaint
source_name: India Code — Ministry of Law & Justice, Govt. of India
simple_explanation_te: గృహ హింసను ఎదుర్కొంటున్న మహిళ నేరుగా మేజిస్ట్రేట్‌ను ఆశ్రయించి రక్షణ ఉత్తర్వులు, నివాస హక్కులు మరియు నెలవారీ ఆర్థిక సహాయాన్ని పొందవచ్చు.

example_explanation: Under DV Act Section 12, the woman can immediately petition the Judicial Magistrate. The Magistrate can pass interim ex-parte protection orders prohibiting violence, restraining dispossession from the shared household (Section 19), and granting interim maintenance (Section 20).
example_explanation_te: సెక్షన్ 12 కింద మహిళ వెంటనే మేజిస్ట్రేట్ కోర్టును ఆశ్రయించవచ్చు. కోర్టు హింసను నిరోధించే రక్షణ ఉత్తర్వులను, ఇంట్లో ఉండే హక్కును మరియు తాత్కాలిక భరణాన్ని మంజూరు చేయవచ్చు.

title: Order for Maintenance of Wives, Children and Parents
legal_text: A Magistrate of the First Class may order a person of sufficient means who neglects or refuses to maintain his wife (including a divorced, unremarried wife), minor children, major children with a disability, or an indigent parent, to pay a monthly allowance. Non-payment can lead to a warrant for the amount as a fine, and imprisonment of up to one month per default, subject to a one-year limit on claiming arrears.
simple_explanation: Lets a wife, child, or parent who cannot support themselves claim monthly maintenance from a person of sufficient means who is neglecting to support them — a fast, religion-neutral remedy that replaced the old CrPC Section 125.
purpose: Prevents destitution of dependents by providing a quick, summary remedy for maintenance.
punishment: Not a penal provision for the underlying conduct — but non-payment of an ordered maintenance amount can lead to a fine (recovered like a warrant) and imprisonment of up to one month per default.
relevant_documents: Marriage/birth certificates, income proof of both parties, any prior maintenance order, application for maintenance.
key_elements:
Applicant's inability to maintain themselves.
Respondent's sufficient means to pay.
Neglect or refusal by the respondent to maintain the applicant.
Relationship (wife, child, or parent) must be established.
A wife's claim can be barred by disqualifying conduct such as living in adultery.
relevant_information:
Proof of relationship — marriage certificate, birth certificates.
Evidence of the applicant's income/inability to self-support.
Evidence of the respondent's income and assets.
Any prior maintenance order (e.g. under the Hindu Marriage Act or DV Act) to avoid double claims.
keywords: maintenance, alimony, wife maintenance, child maintenance, parents maintenance, bnss 144, section 125

simple_explanation_hi: अपना भरण-पोषण करने में असमर्थ पत्नी, नाबालिग बच्चों या वृद्ध माता-पिता को मासिक गुजारा भत्ता देने का अदालत का आदेश। पुरानी सीआरपीसी धारा 125 का स्थान।
punishment_hi: आदेश के बावजूद भरण-पोषण न देने पर बकाया राशि के लिए जेल भेजने का प्रावधान।

example_situation: Suppose an earning adult son with steady substantial income neglects his elderly ailing mother who has no pension, no property, and is unable to afford basic food and medical expenses.
example_situation_te: మంచి ఆదాయం ఉన్న ఒక కుమారుడు ఎటువంటి పెన్షన్ లేదా ఆస్తి లేని తన వృద్ధ తల్లిని పట్టించుకోకుండా వదిలేసి, తిండి మరియు మందుల ఖర్చులను కూడా భరించట్లేదని అనుకుందాం.
example_situation_hi: मान लीजिए एक अच्छी कमाई वाला बेटा अपनी बुजुर्ग बीमार माँ की अनदेखी करता है, जिनके पास आय का कोई साधन नहीं है और वे दवाइयों का खर्च उठाने में असमर्थ हैं।
example_explanation: Under BNSS Section 144, the mother can file a petition before the Judicial Magistrate. If the Magistrate is satisfied regarding the son's sufficient means and neglect, the court will order a reasonable monthly maintenance allowance and interim support during the proceedings.
example_explanation_te: BNSS సెక్షన్ 144 కింద తల్లి మేజిస్ట్రేట్ కోర్టులో పిటిషన్ దాఖలు చేయవచ్చు. కుమారుడికి స్తోమత ఉన్నప్పటికీ నిర్లక్ష్యం చేశాడని తేలితే, కోర్టు నెలవారీ భరణాన్ని చెల్లించాలని ఆదేశిస్తుంది.
example_explanation_hi: बीएनएसएस धारा 144 के तहत माँ मजिस्ट्रेट के समक्ष याचिका दायर कर सकती है। बेटे की आय और उपेक्षा साबित होने पर अदालत मासिक गुजारा भत्ता देने का वैधानिक आदेश पारित करेगी।

title: Information in Cognizable Cases (Mandatory FIR & e-FIR)
legal_text: Every information relating to the commission of a cognizable offence, if given orally to an officer in charge of a police station, shall be reduced to writing by him or under his direction, and be read over to the informant; and every such information, whether given in writing or reduced to writing as aforesaid, shall be signed by the person giving it, and the substance thereof shall be entered in a book to be kept by such officer in such form as the State Government may prescribe in this behalf: Provided that if the information is given by the woman against whom an offence under section 64, section 65, section 66, section 67, section 68, section 69, section 70, section 71, section 74, section 75, section 76, section 77, section 78, section 79 or section 124 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 is alleged to have been committed or attempted, then such information shall be recorded, by a woman police officer or any woman officer. Information may also be given by electronic communication, which shall be taken on record on being signed within three days.
simple_explanation: When a serious (cognizable) crime is reported, the police officer MUST register a First Information Report (FIR). A free copy of the FIR must be given to you immediately. If police refuse, you can send the report to the Superintendent of Police by post or file electronically (e-FIR), which must be formally signed within 3 days.
purpose: Guarantees citizen's fundamental access to criminal justice and mandates prompt police registration of serious crimes.
punishment: A police officer who willfully disobeys direction of law to register FIR is liable under BNS Section 199 with imprisonment up to 2 years.
relevant_documents:
Written complaint
ID proof
Evidence of incident (photos, medical reports, transaction receipts)
Acknowledgement slip
key_elements:
Cognizable offence reported
Oral statement reduced to writing

simple_explanation_hi: जब किसी गंभीर (संज्ञेय) अपराध की सूचना दी जाती है, तो पुलिस अधिकारी को अनिवार्य रूप से एफआईआर दर्ज करनी होगी। एफआईआर की एक निःशुल्क प्रति शिकायतकर्ता को तुरंत दी जानी चाहिए। पुलिस के इनकार करने पर पुलिस अधीक्षक को डाक द्वारा या ई-एफआईआर भेजी जा सकती है।

example_title_hi: चोरी की प्राथमिकी दर्ज करने से पुलिस का इनकार
example_situation: Ramesh had his motorcycle stolen outside a shopping complex. The local police station gave him a handwritten CSR slip instead of registering an FIR.
example_situation_te: షాపింగ్ కాంప్లెక్స్ వెలుపల రమేష్ మోటార్ సైకిల్ దొంగిలించబడింది. స్థానిక పోలీసులు ఎఫ్‌ఐఆర్ నమోదు చేయకుండా సాధారణ రసీదు మాత్రమే ఇచ్చారు.
example_situation_hi: रमेश की मोटरसाइकिल शॉपिंग कॉम्प्लेक्स के बाहर से चोरी हो गई। स्थानीय पुलिस ने एफआईआर दर्ज करने के बजाय केवल अनौपचारिक पर्ची थमा दी।
example_explanation: Under Section 173, theft is cognizable and police have no discretion to deny an FIR. Ramesh sent a written complaint to the SP, who directed immediate FIR registration.
example_explanation_te: సెక్షన్ 173 ప్రకారం దొంగతనం కాగ్నిజబుల్ నేరం కాబట్టి ఎఫ్‌ఐఆర్ నిరాకరించే అధికారం పోలీసులకు లేదు. రమేష్ ఎస్పీకి ఫిర్యాదు చేయడంతో వెంటనే ఎఫ్‌ఐఆర్ నమోదైంది.
example_explanation_hi: धारा 173 के तहत चोरी संज्ञेय अपराध है और पुलिस एफआईआर से इनकार नहीं कर सकती। रमेश द्वारा एसपी को शिकायत भेजने पर तुरंत एफआईआर दर्ज की गई।
